title: JAB — The Best of the Monster Games
description: Explore a maze, evade Jabberwockies, and set timed explosive drops.
versionOrder: Inferred development sequence: Amazing-based maze/monster forms, then the replacement maze generator on tape16a, then the closely related tape30a save with revised controls and random routine. Tape numbers alone do not establish chronology. The damaged tape16a save 5 is preserved separately and is not filled from any complete save.

versions.startupSource:
3 ON ERROR GOTO 10001
5 REM THE BEST OF THE MONSTER GAMES ---- JAB
10 CLEAR 100:DEFINT C,N
20 CLS:PRINT"WORKING"
30 W=70:L=40:Z2=.3
40 IF W/2<>INT(W/2) THEN W=W-1
50 IF L/2<>INT(L/2) THEN L=L-1
60 DIM C(W,L),NS(30,3)
70 FOR X=1 TO W-1 STEP 2:FOR Y=1 TO L-1 STEP 2:C(X,Y)=2:NEXTY,X
71 GOSUB 1000:' ************
80 X=RND(W-1):Y=RND(L/2-1)*2:IF X/2=INT(X/2) THEN Y=Y-1
90 C(X,Y)=2:ZZ=ZZ+1:IFZZ/W/L<Z2 THEN 80

attribution.text: Early maze versions adapt Jack Hauber’s Amazing; later JAB versions replace the maze generator.
